description: Local MCP only: capture current filtered files, including uncommitted/new files, and save one managed version without importing Git history. Use initialize for unbound source, commit for managed source, or explicit switch for the current GitHub project's move to managed; project URL and data stay with that project. Honors nested ignore rules and excludes credentials, links, dependencies and generated output. Rejects symlinks and changing files. Reuse the key after uncertainty and observe the upload before any new attempt; publication is a separate deployment action.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: source_publish
